profile.description: 2026 Color Country OHV Jamboree is confirmed for Sept. 25-28 in Parowan/Iron County. Adventure Zone emailed the event in 2024. Operational fit is weak because participants spend much of each day away on organized OHV rides; gathering time is concentrated around meals, parade, raffles and evening activities.

notes.subject: 2026 review — weak audience-flow fit
notes.body: Iron County public meeting material confirms the 2026 Color Country OHV Jamboree for Sept. 25-28. Gmail shows Adventure Zone outreach in Jan. 2024. Typical event programming is built around early-morning/day OHV rides, night rides, parade, banquet/BBQ and raffles, meaning attendees are away from the grounds for large portions of the operating day. Do not prioritize a full staffed inflatable carnival unless organizers identify a separate public/family component with sustained foot traffic.
